title: conditional eval fanout + weighted signal aggregator and CI gating
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: when a primary prompt-set check trips, we often need to run a set of targeted probes (e.g. hallucination prober, paraphrase-stability, token-saliency) to determine failure mode before blocking rollouts. This PR adds a conditional eval fanout layer and a weighted signal aggregator so CI can produce a single composite gating decision that reflects both severity and breadth of regressions. Design summary: - New runtime component eval_fanout orchestrates conditional parallel probes with a budget cap and backpressure to avoid blowing smoke-test windows. - WeightedSignalAggregator implements decay-weighted aggregation across cohorts and probes; weights are configurable per-linear-task and default to severity-first then coverage. - CiHook composite_slo_check integrates into existing eval CI: primary prompt-set runs as usual; on fail, fanout triggers configured probes; aggregator emits a human-readable breakdown and a single pass/fail decision. - Added JSON schema for fanout plan (configs/ : fanout-plans/*.json) and migration docs. Changes (high level): - eval/engine/fanout.py (core orchestration + retry/backoff) - eval/metrics/aggregator.py (aggregation logic, normalization) - eval/ci/composite_slo_hook.py (CI entrypoint + reporter) - configs/fanout-plans/english-and-multilingual.json - tests/{unit,integration}/test_fanout_* and smoke scenarios - docs/eval/fanout-design.md (motivation and configuration guide) Checklist: - [x] Unit tests covering core aggregator math and scheduling heuristics - [x] Integration smoke that runs fanout on a small sample prompt set within CI budget - [x] CI gating rule added and tested in staging - [x] Backwards-compatible configs (existing eval runs unchanged unless plan specified) Rollout plan: merge to main, enable composite_slo_check behind feature-flag per-repo, monitor eval/telemetry.composite_gate.* metrics for two weeks, then flip default for canaries. Related: ENG-2048 for production tuning, ENG-2110 for policy UI knobs. Notes: kept probes as light-weight callable adapters so adding new probes doesn't require changing orchestration core. See internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/board/ENG-2048/fanout-spec for full design.
commits: a1f4c9b: core fanout orchestrator and basic budget/backpressure
b2e8d30: weighted aggregator + normalization and schema validators
c3d4f12: CI hook + reporter + smoke tests + docs
commit_summary: Core orchestration, aggregator math, CI hook, probes and tests split across three commits. Key behavior: fanout only triggers on primary check fail and will stop early when aggregator reaches decisive threshold; probes run with per-probe concurrency limits to protect CI budget.
review_comments: Marcus Li (review): overall looks solid. Question: how do we ensure fanout probes cannot cause flakiness by increasing non-determinism in CI? Please add deterministic seeding for probes in integration runs.
Ava Chen (author): added deterministic seeding in tests and included a note in fanout-design.md; also added a smoke integration with fixed RNG seeds.
Hannah Ortiz (review): can we expose the weight config via the console UI later? For now, ensure the defaults are conservative. Also requested clearer error codes from aggregator.
Ava Chen (author): weights are configurable via configs/fanout-plans/*.json; added a small config validation with helpful error messages. Filed follow-up ENG-2110 to add UI surface.
Diego Ramos (approval): minor nits addressed, approving. Recommend monitoring composite_gate.false_positive_rate metric after rollout.
ci_checks: integration-eval: failed on first run (timeout on paraphrase probe), rerun -> pass
release_notes: Adds conditional evaluation fanout and a weighted signal aggregator to enable composite CI gating across prompt-set regressions. Enables configurable probe fanout plans and adds an opt-in CI hook 'composite_slo_check'. Monitor composite_gate.* telemetry after rollout.
notes_for_oncall: If composite_slo_check starts causing unexpected CI volume, disable feature-flag 'composite_slo_check' in CI config and open ENG-2048 for investigation. Key metrics: eval.latency.p95, composite_gate.decision_latency, composite_gate.false_positive_rate.
